notes_for_editor: Thin: the only tower-specific source is the Georgia tower list, which gives coordinates, elevation and county, with no codes for this tower. Several searches (websearch.py and WebSearch) found no history of a Hilyer tower, and the pages they pointed to (Pastmaps map, Atlanta Trails, Vanishing Georgia) did not mention one. The NHLR Georgia list (29 lookouts) and FFLOS Georgia list (2 former sites), fetched 2026-10-21, have no Hilyer entry. The name 'hilyer' is the list's own label (tower 146 is above 73). The story is about 90 words because nothing else is supported. A search snippet suggested asking the GFC unit in LaGrange; that is a suggestion, not a source, and is not used.
